name: OW4P1-reaim-same-walk
note: AUDIT OW4 P1: the leader re-aims a spot in the same pixel while it walks and gets the old walk back with the old sx/sz - the members walk on to A and are released there.

name: OW4P1-one-axis
note: AUDIT OW4 P1: a spot re-aimed north or south of the old one (the same x) is taken for the same point.

name: OW4P1-walking-never-rerouted
note: AUDIT OW4 P1: a member still walking an older set-out is never re-routed to the new one - they walk on to the old point.

name: OW4P2-halt-forever
old: if (walkHaltLapsed(tw, now)) return { tw: null, halt: false };   // AUDIT OW4 P2: off the pose, never set out again
note: AUDIT OW4 P2: a halted walk never expires - a halted spot walk rides the pose for ever, and a Resume an hour later sets every yes-member out unasked.

name: OW4P2-begin-revives
old: const live = walkHaltLapsed(prev, now) ? null : prev;
note: AUDIT OW4 P2: a lapsed halt taken up again by the leader's click (nobody gathered) sets the old round out again.

name: OW4P2-walking-lapses
old: return !!tw && tw.h != null && now - tw.h > PARTY_WALK_HALT_MS;
note: AUDIT OW4 P2: a long walk that WALKS is taken for a lapsed halt - the leader's same click becomes a new round.

name: OW4P2-bound-short
note: AUDIT OW4 P2: a bound shorter than a band's chase and its fight drops the walk from under a party still fighting.

name: OW4P3-box-lost-under-push
note: AUDIT OW4 P3: the question with a window pushed over it is forgotten - it surfaces later untracked and answerable, never down with its round.

name: OW4P3-buried-box-live
note: AUDIT OW4 P3: the question taken down while buried is left live (the identity guard leaves it) - it surfaces answerable past its round.

name: OW4P3-stale-yes
old: if (walkAskStands({ tw: _walkHeard?.tw ?? null, round, now: walkNow(), danger: walkDanger() })) _walkMine = { at: round, yes, go: null };
note: AUDIT OW4 P3: a yes pressed after the asking (or with a foe near) still starts the member.

name: OW4P3-stale-yes-in-danger
old: danger: walkDanger() })) _walkMine = { at: round, yes, go: null };
new: danger: false })) _walkMine = { at: round, yes, go: null };
note: AUDIT OW4 P3: a yes pressed with a foe come near, before the step takes the question down, still counts.

name: OW4P3-stack-is-slot
note: AUDIT OW4 P3: the talk host answers for its slot, not its stack - a box under a pushed window reads as gone.

name: OW4P3-withdraw-live
note: AUDIT OW4 P3: a withdrawn question still answers - a key on it as it surfaces runs its arm.

name: OW4P4-balk-is-stop
note: AUDIT OW4 P4: a journey that cannot run is a plain stop - set out on every Resume, it stops at once and halts the party again.

name: OW4P4-balk-restarted
note: AUDIT OW4 P4: the balked member is set out by the party's next Resume, stops at once, and the leader halts again.

name: OW4P4-host-why-unsaid
note: AUDIT OW4 P4: the travel frame never says why a journey stopped - every balk reads as a plain stop.

name: OW4P4-host-why-stale
old: _walkStopWhy = null;   // AUDIT OW4 P4: read once - a stop's reason is its own step's
note: AUDIT OW4 P4: an old balk's reason outlives it - a later plain stop (a window) is read as a balk and the party passes the member by.

name: OW4P4-host-balk-unmarked
note: AUDIT OW4 P4: the balk is said but not kept - the next set-out starts the member again.

name: OW4P4-host-balk-halts-nobody
note: AUDIT OW4 P4: a balk is never said - the party walks on without the member, unhalted (a stop for one is no longer a stop for all).

name: OW4P4-host-balk-kept
old: _walkMine = { ..._walkMine, go: tw.go, yes: ok, balk: false };
note: AUDIT OW4 P4: the member who took their balk up themselves stays balked - a later plain stop and the party's Resume passes them by.

name: OW4P5-arrival-sets-out
note: AUDIT OW4 P5: a set-out landing during a fast-travel arrival plans the member's route from where the feet read mid-move.

name: OW4P6-own-resume-halted
note: AUDIT OW4 P6: a member's own Resume to the walk's place under a halt is stopped within a step, silently, for as long as the leader stands.

name: OW4P6-host-was-unpassed
note: AUDIT OW4 P6: the host never says whether the halt stopped me - every own Resume under it reads as the halt landing, and is stopped.

name: OW4P7-far-member-asked
note: AUDIT OW4 P7: a member far off is asked (killed by the lifted run - no regex pins this line).

name: OW4P7-mod-journey-unread
old: return s?.pixel ? { x: s.pixel.x, y: s.pixel.y, spot: false } : null;
note: AUDIT OW4 P7: walkDestLive's third branch (the mod's own named journey) - the hand copy dropped it; the leader's Resume by the mod's map ends the walk (killed by the lifted run).
